cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You put a folded napkin under that cafe chair, so I've put napkins under every leg. Shall we do the whole room?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only that one leg was short. Now you've raised the chair and it still wobbles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, we need the whole room level. We'll lift the floorboards and start underneath.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We open in twenty minutes. Take your napkins out and I'll deal with the short leg.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep yours in as the height marker. I'll tell the customers we're closed; we can level the counter while the floor's up.

reason: Copy B successful small shim incorrectly, then make the correction and opening deadline fuel an enlarged project.
